Kricketot

Bug

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Kricketot is a Bug-type Cricket Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 2.2 kg. It evolves into Kricketune. Its highest base stat is Defense (41), with a base stat total of 194.
